rca of the issue: Previously CartoDB dark_all tiles returned key-gated placeholder images with 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark. Fix switched TileLayer URL to OpenStreetMap standard tiles (key-free) and applied a CSS filter (.leaflet-tile invert+hue-rotate+brightness/contrast/saturate) to retain dark aesthetic. Verified by inspecting tile img src (openstreetmap.org domain) and body text (no 'API KEY' occurrences).
